A.S. Paralegal

Step into a rewarding career in the legal field with a Paralegal Studies associate’s degree from Sullivan University. This online paralegal degree gives you the opportunity to develop the expertise to thrive in a range of legal settings, from law firms to government agencies and corporate legal departments. You’ll gain essential skills in legal research, document drafting, and client interviews—all while learning from current practitioners. This curriculum not only deepens your paralegal knowledge, but also integrates business and general education courses, preparing you for a variety of entry-level paralegal positions.

*Paralegals may not provide legal services directly to the public, except as permitted by law.

Curriculum

Overview

The Paralegal associate’s degree is designed to enhance students’ skills by combining advanced paralegal coursework with business-related and general-education courses. It prepares graduates for a wide range of entry-level paralegal roles, equipping them with the expertise needed to succeed in the legal field.

This flexible, work-at-your-own pace degree allows students to balance their studies with other commitments. *There is a requirement of 13.5 quarter credits of legal specialty courses through synchronous instruction.
